claims.paper_source: Expanded main paper Section 4; Phase 21 Mellin reconstruction

Direct completed-zeta balls overlap two rigorously tailed integral normalizations at n=0..3, but the concrete general theta-kernel moment identity remains paper analysis.

claims.remaining_boundary: Lean checks exact denominator/norm margins and the generic unique closed-disc contraction implication; Arb certifies three small complex Rouché boxes with Q nonvanishing. A concrete whole-disc self-map certificate, full-sector patching, and logarithmic asymptotics remain paper analysis.

claims.paper_source: Expanded main paper Section 6; Phase 21 leading contour localization
claims.remaining_boundary: Arb encloses the horizontal contour, central window, connector, and Gaussian ratio at three points. Uniform contour deformation and signed-cubic cancellation remain paper analysis.

claims.statement: Uniform suppression of higher theta modes

claims.remaining_boundary: Lean proves that a uniform holomorphic relative error on an enclosing disc transports to every derivative, explicitly through order six. Arb verifies selected coefficient, saddle, contour, and theta-mode ingredients, but construction of that uniform sectorial error and the fixed-sector Stirling assembly remain paper analysis.

The finite adapter is complete; construction of the four analytic quotient equalities belongs to T8--T9.

policy: Baseline classification: green requires a kernel proof or complete paper proof with multiple independent channels; amber records a complete candidate proof with an explicit formal or external-input boundary; red records an unresolved correctness gap.
